variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: Local Docker PostgreSQL (host network from run-hop.sh)

variables.name: DB_PORT
variables.description: PostgreSQL port (non-default to avoid collision with host PostgreSQL on 5432)

variables.name: DB_SOURCE_NAME
variables.description: PostgreSQL database for CRM source landing tables

variables.name: DB_TARGET_NAME
variables.description: PostgreSQL database for Data Vault / Business Vault / dimensional targets

variables.name: DB_OPS_NAME
variables.description: PostgreSQL database for execution metrics / load-run operations tables

variables.name: MARQUEZ_API
variables.description: Export data lineage HTTP POST URL (one RunEvent per request)

variables.name: MARQUEZ_BASE_URL
variables.description: Marquez host root for Hop Lineage View backends (no /api/v1/lineage)

variables.name: MARQUEZ_NAMESPACE_DATASET
variables.description: The namespace to use in Marquez

variables.name: MARQUEZ_NAMESPACE_JOB
variables.description: The namespace to use in Marquez

variables.name: HOP_LICENSE_HEADER_FILE
variables.description: Serialize the Apache-2.0 license header into DV, BV, DM, and execution-map XML files
